lines.zh: （谷仓墙根旁，一架短木梯侧倒在地，
lines.en: (By the barn wall, a short wooden ladder lies on its side,
*hic—*
Who…

lines.zh: 淑芬的蛋不见了。你看到过什么吗？
lines.en: Shufen's egg is gone. Did you see anything?

lines.zh: （大黄的耳朵动了一下，目光慢慢聚过来）
lines.en: (Dahuang's ear twitches. His eyes slowly come into focus)
The egg… the crow… carried it off.
The crow?

lines.zh: 嗯……乌鸦往谷仓屋顶飞了。我追了，跳不上去，就咬到一嘴空气。
lines.en: Mm… the crow flew to the barn roof. I chased it, couldn't jump up, and bit a mouthful of air.

lines.zh: （大黄把脑袋重新压回前爪上，声音低下去）
lines.en: (Dahuang lowers his head back onto his paws. His voice drops)

lines.zh: 我失职了……没护住淑芬的蛋。
lines.en: I failed… I didn't protect Shufen's egg.

lines.zh: 你身下压着一架短木梯，能先挪一下吗？
lines.en: There's a short ladder under you. Can you shift over first?

lines.zh: （大黄迷迷糊糊蹬了下腿，短梯反而被压得更实）
lines.en: (Dahuang drowsily kicks. The ladder gets pinned even harder)
…Don't push…
*hic…*
Dahuang, drink this first.
Dahuang, wake up.
I'll come back later.

lines.zh: （大黄眯着眼凑近闻了闻，探出舌头慢慢吮着喝，中途顿了顿，又埋头接着喝）
lines.en: (Dahuang squints, leans in to sniff, sticks out his tongue and drinks slowly. He pauses, then buries his head and keeps drinking)

lines.zh: （片刻后，大黄猛地甩了下脑袋——湿树叶从额头飞出去）
lines.en: (A moment later Dahuang flings his head — the wet leaf flies off his forehead)
*urk—*

lines.zh: （大黄使劲眨眼，目光开始聚焦）
lines.en: (Dahuang blinks hard. His eyes start to focus)

lines.zh: （四肢从梯子上撑起来，摇摇晃晃站稳）
lines.en: (He pushes up off the ladder and stands, swaying)
…Mm. Clearer now.

lines.zh: （大黄哼了一声，把头埋进前爪里）
lines.en: (Dahuang huffs and buries his head in his paws)
*hic…* quiet…

lines.zh: 这样叫不醒。得找点能让他清醒的东西。
lines.en: Calling won't wake him. I need something that can sober him up.

lines.zh: 这样叫不醒。得先让他清醒过来，短梯才借得出来。
lines.en: Calling won't wake him. He has to sober up before I can borrow the ladder.
Anything else?
Can I borrow the ladder?
Whose nest is that in the barn?
Is this the egg you chased?
Nothing else for now.

lines.zh: 大黄，梯子能借我吗？入口那道小围墙，我得翻过去。
lines.en: Dahuang, can I borrow the ladder? I have to get over that little wall by the entrance.
The ladder?

lines.zh: （大黄扭头看向身侧那架侧倒的木梯）
lines.en: (Dahuang turns and looks at the fallen ladder beside him)
Oh. Right. Take it.

lines.zh: （大黄用前爪把木梯往这边推了推）
lines.en: (Dahuang pushes the ladder this way with a paw)
Set it steady before you climb. Don't fall.

lines.zh: 谷仓角落有一片被压扁的草窝，你知道是哪个动物的吗？
lines.en: There's a flattened grass nest in the corner of the barn. Do you know whose it is?
That grass nest in the barn corner?
(Dahuang frowns, trying to remember)

lines.zh: 前两天好像瞥见两个灰乎乎的小东西窜过去，太快了，没看清。
lines.en: A couple of days ago I thought I saw two gray little things dart past. Too fast. Didn't see them clearly.

lines.zh: 也可能是我那两天喝糊涂了。
lines.en: Or maybe I was too drunk those days.

lines.zh: 大黄，你看这个——是不是你那天追的蛋？
lines.en: Dahuang, look at this — is this the egg you chased that day?

lines.zh: （大黄低头凑近，仔细盯着摊开的笔记本）
lines.en: (Dahuang lowers his head and stares at the open notebook)
This is… what?
(Dahuang's eyes go wide. He leans closer)
A rock?
(Dahuang lifts his head and freezes)

lines.zh: ……跟乌鸦叼走那玩意儿，形状差不多。
lines.en: …It's about the same shape as the thing the crow carried off.

lines.zh: 乌鸦一直守着这块石头，说是他的部落图腾宝石。
lines.en: The crow has been guarding this rock. He says it's his tribe's totem gem.
(Dahuang stares at the notebook, not moving)

lines.zh: 所以乌鸦叼走的……不是淑芬的蛋？
lines.en: So what the crow took… wasn't Shufen's egg?
Then I'm not a useless guard!

lines.zh: （尾巴猛地甩动起来，停不下来）
lines.en: (His tail starts whipping and won't stop)
Shufen's egg must still be out there!
(Dahuang jolts and takes a deep breath)

lines.zh: （在某个方向停下来，神情郑重）
lines.en: (He stops facing one direction, solemn)

lines.zh: 蛋的气味在那边——红顶屋那一片。主人住的那栋，过了桥就到。
lines.en: The egg's scent is that way — the red-roof house. Where the owner lives. Across the bridge.

lines.zh: （大黄在红顶屋外站定，尾巴轻轻绷着）
lines.en: (Dahuang stops outside the red-roof house, tail held tight)
Right here.
Go look at that door first.
Find anything?
Can't get in the front door.

lines.zh: 红屋顶里还住着别的动物？
lines.en: Are there other animals living in the red-roof house?
Nothing yet.

lines.zh: ……那怎么办啊。侦探，你再看看，我待会儿也试试。
lines.en: …Then what do we do. Detective, look again. I'll try in a bit too.

lines.zh: 这里有一扇精美的小门，还有一撮动物的毛，
lines.en: There's a fine little door here, and a tuft of animal fur,

lines.zh: （大黄愣了一下，猛地用爪子拍了下自己脑门）
lines.en: (Dahuang blinks, then smacks his forehead with a paw)

lines.zh: 哎哟！我这狗脑子，准是酒还没醒透！
lines.en: Ow! This dog brain of mine — the drink still hasn't worn off!
What did you remember?

lines.zh: 有只猫！那只傲慢的黑猫！
lines.en: A cat! That arrogant black cat!
Where is he?
In the great oak!
(Both paws on the trunk, he shakes it hard)

lines.zh: 猫大爷！下来！这事儿得你出马！
lines.en: Lord Cat! Come down! We need you on this!

lines.zh: 大黄，你认识那只黑猫很久了吗？
lines.en: Dahuang, have you known that black cat a long time?

lines.zh: 挺久的。他刚来的时候……比我一只爪子还小。
lines.en: Quite a while. When he first came… he was smaller than one of my paws.

lines.zh: （大黄往下看了看自己的爪子）
lines.en: (Dahuang looks down at his own paw)

lines.zh: 那会儿什么都不懂，连怎么爬树都不会。我教过他一次。
lines.en: He didn't know anything then. Couldn't even climb a tree. I taught him once.
Did he learn?

lines.zh: 学会了。后来他就不理我了。
lines.en: He did. After that he stopped talking to me.
Was he afraid of anything as a kitten?
Rain.
(Dahuang scratches an ear)

lines.zh: 我后来提过一次，他说从来没进过我狗窝、那种地方。
lines.en: I mentioned it later. He said he'd never been in my doghouse, that kind of place.
(Dahuang looks toward where the black cat is crouched)
He's still there.
What?

lines.zh: 我说，他还没走。换别的猫，被人从树上晃下来，早溜了。
lines.en: I said he hasn't left. Any other cat, shaken out of a tree, would've bolted.

lines.zh: （大黄若无其事地往旁边挪了半步）
lines.en: (Dahuang casually shifts half a step aside)

lines.zh: 他在听呢。就是不想让人看出来。
lines.en: He's listening. He just doesn't want anyone to notice.

lines.zh: （大黄坐在橡树旁，望向红顶屋方向）
lines.en: (Dahuang sits by the oak, looking toward the red-roof house)
I'll keep watch.

lines.zh: （大黄仰头看向红顶屋屋顶，尾巴轻轻摇着）
lines.en: (Dahuang looks up at the red roof, tail swaying gently)
Go on. I'll wait here.
On patrol. All clear.

lines.zh: 大黄，那块石头最后怎么了？
lines.en: Dahuang, what happened to that rock in the end?

lines.zh: 还在乌鸦那儿。我问过，它说是部落图腾宝石，了不得。
lines.en: Still with the crow. I asked. It says it's a tribal totem gem. A big deal.
(Dahuang scratches an ear)
…Let it be.

lines.zh: 我想……下次再碰见苹果渣，不喝了。
lines.en: I think… next time I see apple mash, I won't drink it.
(A pause)
I'm a guard. Not a drunk.

lines.zh: 大黄，以后还会有蛋失踪吗？
lines.en: Dahuang, will another egg go missing?
No.
(Dahuang looks down at his collar, then up)
My nose works just fine.

lines.zh: 每次打雷，他就跑来我狗窝旁边蹲着。
lines.en: Every time it thunders, he comes and crouches beside my doghouse.

lines.zh: 我说进来吧，他说本喵只是路过，
lines.en: I say come in. He says this cat is only passing by,

lines.zh: 一只黄毛大狗半压在上面，低沉的鼾声带着哨音）
lines.en: A big yellow dog half-sprawled on top of it, a low snore with a whistle)

lines.zh: 谷仓入口那道矮墙翻不过去。
lines.en: Can't get over the low wall at the barn entrance.

lines.zh: 他有专属猫门，钥匙就挂脖子上！
lines.en: He has his own cat door. The key hangs on his neck!

lines.zh: 然后在门口站了整整一夜。
lines.en: Then he stood in the doorway the whole night.
That's just how he is. Mouth harder than stone.
I'll go on ahead. See you past the bridge!

lines.zh: （树冠剧烈颤动，一只黑猫从树上落地，毛发炸乱，白眼一翻）
lines.en: (The crown of the tree shakes hard. A black cat drops from it, fur exploded, eyes rolling)
Get—away!

lines.zh: 没看到本喵正为被骗的事疗伤吗？！
lines.en: Can't you see this cat is nursing a wound from being tricked?!
Wait… that voice…
You're that tree!!
…It's a cat.
(Dahuang lowers his voice)
You talked to the tree?
I thought… the tree was talking…

lines.zh: （黑猫深吸一口气，抬爪梳了两下乱毛，没梳平，更烦）
lines.en: (The black cat takes a deep breath, licks twice at the messy fur, fails, and gets more annoyed)
That damned two-legs!

lines.zh: 昨晚装得可温柔，骗本喵放松——
lines.en: Last night he acted so gentle, got this cat to relax—

lines.zh: 他把本喵捧起来，本喵以为是要按摩——
lines.en: He picked this cat up. This cat thought it was a massage—

lines.zh: 一转眼就把本喵搁在冰冷地板上！
lines.en: Next moment he set this cat down on the cold floor!
Stole this cat's personal cushion!
Ah… that is pretty rude.
And you!

lines.zh: （黑猫视线漫不经心扫过大黄）
lines.en: (The black cat's gaze drifts idly over Dahuang)
…That bird calls you a carpet.
What?!
…I didn't mishear.
(A one-second pause)

lines.zh: 你还把树晃成那样？！这是什么不文明的手段？！
lines.en: And you shook the tree like that?! What kind of uncivilized method is that?!
You wouldn't come down if I didn't.
(The black cat's gaze slides over and stops)
…And who are you?

lines.zh: 我是侦探，在调查淑芬的蛋失踪案。
lines.en: I'm the detective, investigating Shufen's missing egg.

lines.zh: 鸡的事，和本喵有什么关系。
lines.en: A chicken's business. What does it have to do with this cat.

lines.zh: （黑猫在橡树根旁蹲下，尾巴慢慢扫地，没挪窝）
lines.en: (The black cat crouches by the oak roots, tail slowly sweeping the ground, not moving)

lines.zh: 我查到的，都指向红顶屋里面。
lines.en: Everything I found points inside the red-roof house.

lines.zh: 我还有新发现要跟你说。
lines.en: I have something new to tell you.
That grass nest in the barn… it's yours, isn't it.

lines.zh: 有关你要我办的那件事。
lines.en: About that thing you asked me to do.

lines.zh: 你要的东西，我还在想办法。
lines.en: The thing you want — I'm still working on it.
I got it back.
That time you went up on the barn roof—
I won't bother you now.
…Go on.
This cat doesn't promise to like it.

lines.zh: 淑芬今天早上醒来，蛋不见了。
lines.en: Shufen woke up this morning and the egg was gone.
…And then.

lines.zh: 但窝里没有打斗迹象，没有外来气味，也没有拖拽痕迹。
lines.en: But there were no signs of a fight in the nest, no outside scent, and no drag marks.

lines.zh: 窝里没打斗，也没拖拽痕迹。
lines.en: No fight in the nest, and no drag marks.
It walked off on its own?
Dahuang's nose just came back,

lines.zh: 那只蠢狗的鼻子，在这件事上倒是有用。
lines.en: That stupid dog's nose is actually useful on this.

lines.zh: 还有昨晚悲伤蛙看见了什么——
lines.en: And what the sad frog saw last night—

lines.zh: 高大的两脚兽，带着冰冷的容器，
lines.en: A tall two-legs, with a cold container,

lines.zh: ……那只蛤蟆的措辞一向如诗如画。
lines.en: …That toad's wording is always poetic.
(The black cat says nothing. His eyes turn slowly)

lines.zh: 但「冰冷的容器」和「生命之源」——对得上什么，你继续说。
lines.en: But "cold container" and "source of life" — tell me what they match.
Go on.

lines.zh: 池塘那边有人打水——红顶屋门外，能拿出什么证明？
lines.en: Someone drew water at the pond — outside the red-roof house, what proof can you produce?
…I'll look outside the red-roof house again.
Go.

lines.zh: 门旁空水桶，桶底池塘泥。
lines.en: An empty bucket by the door. Pond mud in the bottom.

lines.zh: 雨靴脚印，夜里朝鸡窝方向。
lines.en: Rain-boot prints, heading toward the coop at night.
That's all for now.

lines.zh: 门旁有个空水桶，桶底是池塘泥沙。
lines.en: There's an empty bucket by the door. The bottom is pond silt.

lines.zh: （黑猫视线落在来人身上，停了一秒）
lines.en: (The black cat's gaze lands on the visitor and holds for a second)

lines.zh: 蛤蟆说的冰冷容器——就是这只桶。
lines.en: The toad's cold container — it's this bucket.

lines.zh: 水桶刚装过池塘水，正好对上悲伤蛙说的「生命之源」。
lines.en: The bucket just held pond water. That matches what the sad frog called the "source of life."

lines.zh: （黑猫尾巴慢了下来，不再扫地，只是压着）
lines.en: (The black cat's tail slows, stops sweeping, and just presses down)

lines.zh: 门前的雨靴脚印，夜里朝鸡窝方向。
lines.en: Rain-boot prints in front of the door, heading toward the coop at night.
(The black cat stops)

lines.zh: 脚印朝鸡窝去。是夜里留下的。
lines.en: The prints go toward the coop. Left at night.
One report isn't enough.
…I'll look again.

lines.zh: 昨晚，有人去池塘取了水。
lines.en: Last night, someone went to the pond for water.
Then, at night, they went to the coop.

lines.zh: 现在，蛋的气味从红顶屋里飘出来。
lines.en: Now the egg's scent is coming out of the red-roof house.
(Silence)

lines.zh: 那家伙昨晚进鸡窝拿走了蛋。
lines.en: That guy went into the coop last night and took the egg.
Carried it into the red-roof house.
But why?
This cat wants to know too.
(Starts to stand, then sits back down)
What he's doing with that egg.

lines.zh: 谷仓角落那里……那个草窝，是你的吧？
lines.en: That corner of the barn… that grass nest. It's yours, isn't it?

lines.zh: 旁边还有烧焦的稻草和皮毛。
lines.en: There's scorched straw and fur beside it.
(The black cat's eyes snap up and lock)
…How do you know about that.
What are those burn marks?
None other than that dead bird—
(He stops himself at once)
…But that has nothing to do with you.

lines.zh: （黑猫视线往红顶屋墙缝一飘，很快收回；尾巴尖弹了一下）
lines.en: (The black cat's gaze flicks to a crack in the red-roof wall, then back. The tip of his tail flicks)
Does it have to do with the mice?
…What are you guessing at.

lines.zh: 我帮你把这事办妥——你帮我开屋子。
lines.en: I get this done for you — you open the house for me.

lines.zh: （黑猫眯眼打量来人，好一会儿没吭声）
lines.en: (The black cat squints at the visitor and says nothing for a while)
Go find the mice.
Get the thing back first.
(The black cat's eyelid moves. He stays crouched)
…Speak.
I found what you wanted.

lines.zh: （黑猫耳朵竖起来，尾巴尖不受控地弹了一下）
lines.en: (The black cat's ears stand up. The tip of his tail flicks, out of his control)
Where.

lines.zh: 绿油油的，带着一股冲鼻子的草本甜气——
lines.en: Bright green, with a sharp herbal sweetness that hits the nose—

lines.zh: 池塘里有只蛙一直坐在上面呢。
lines.en: There's a frog at the pond who's been sitting on it.

lines.zh: （黑猫往前倾了半寸，瞳孔放大，又立刻坐正）
lines.en: (The black cat leans forward half an inch, pupils wide, then sits up straight at once)
I asked him to his face. He wouldn't give it up.
Do you have a way?

lines.zh: （黑猫顿住，胡须压平，一秒后又摆回傲慢脸）
lines.en: (The black cat pauses, whiskers flat, then puts the arrogant face back on a second later)

lines.zh: 怎么落到蛤蟆手里——本喵也不知道。
lines.en: How it ended up with the toad — this cat doesn't know either.

lines.zh: 你拿不回来，就去找老鼠。
lines.en: If you can't get it back, go find the mice.
They'll have a way.
(The mint fish is offered)

lines.zh: （黑猫耳朵竖起来，尾巴拍了两下——立刻压住）
lines.en: (The black cat's ears stand up. His tail thumps twice — then he pins it)
…Hmph.

lines.zh: （慢慢走近，低头闻了一下，忍了一秒，吸了一大口——喉咙里半秒呼噜，骤然停住）
lines.en: (He comes closer, lowers his head, sniffs, holds for a second, then takes a huge breath — half a purr in his throat, then it stops dead)
Mrow… that's it — no!
(He steps back half a pace and pins the fish with a paw)
One stinking fish cannot buy this cat!
(Quietly) You purred just now…
Your ears are broken.

lines.zh: 猫大爷，昨晚的事你清楚吗？
lines.en: Lord Cat, do you know what happened last night?
Dahuang, stop talking…

lines.zh: 你可是被那个两脚兽当面骗了一手啊！
lines.en: You got played to your face by that two-legs!

lines.zh: 整个农场都看着你睡得呼呼的、还以为是要给你按摩——
lines.en: The whole farm watched you sleep like a log, thinking he was going to give you a massage—

lines.zh: ——醒来一看，软垫没了，自尊扫地！
lines.en: —You wake up, the cushion's gone, and your pride is in the dirt!

lines.zh: 这要是传出去，今年冬天你睡稻草堆里，
lines.en: If this gets out, this winter you'll be sleeping in a straw pile,

lines.zh: （黑猫的尾巴猛地弹了一下，然后静止）
lines.en: (The black cat's tail snaps once, then goes still)

lines.zh: （非常缓慢地，从蹲位站起来；用眼神冻住大黄——大黄讪讪地把头转开）
lines.en: (Very slowly, he rises from the crouch. His eyes freeze Dahuang — Dahuang sheepishly turns his head away)

lines.zh: 本喵不是因为那只发疯母鸡。
lines.en: This cat is not doing it for that frantic hen.

lines.zh: 也不是因为这条蠢狗指使。
lines.en: And not because this stupid dog told me to.
(He lowers his head and picks up the mint fish in his mouth)

lines.zh: 本喵要进屋查清——软垫被弄哪儿去了，那家伙昨晚又拿它做过什么。
lines.en: This cat is going inside to find out — where the cushion went, and what that guy did with it last night.

lines.zh: 本喵要查清——软垫被弄哪儿去了，那家伙昨晚又拿它做过什么。
lines.en: This cat will find out — where the cushion went, and what that guy did with it last night.
This cat has to see it with his own eyes.
As for that broken egg you mentioned—

lines.zh: 看见了吗？阁楼那个窗子——要进来，你走那边。
lines.en: See it? That window in the attic — if you want in, go that way.
(The black cat slips neatly through the cat door)

lines.zh: （片刻后，红屋顶阁楼的窗子被从内推开，传来一声清脆的啪嗒）
lines.en: (A moment later the attic window of the red roof is pushed open from inside. A crisp click)

lines.zh: 你上谷仓屋顶那次——是不是已经知道那是块石头？
lines.en: That time you went up on the barn roof — did you already know it was a rock?
(The black cat pauses and licks a paw)

lines.zh: 嗯。今早在窗台上看见的——乌鸦往下俯冲，爪里那块白石头，晨光一照就闪。
lines.en: Mm. Saw it on the windowsill this morning — the crow dove, and that white rock in his claws flashed in the morning light.
(The black cat glances at Dahuang)

lines.zh: 任何不瞎的都看得出来不是蛋。
lines.en: Anyone who isn't blind could tell it wasn't an egg.
Why didn't you say so!!

lines.zh: 那只乌鸦，每天早上四点开始嘎嘎嘎。
lines.en: That crow starts cawing at four every morning.
It's been three years.

lines.zh: 让你多跑几圈，本喵觉得挺公平。
lines.en: Making you run a few extra laps seemed fair to this cat.
(The black cat tilts his head, the corner of his mouth lifting)

lines.zh: 本喵在树上不是说过吗？
lines.en: Didn't this cat say it from the tree?
"A fool is showing off. A blind one is asking everywhere."
…Wait.

lines.zh: 那句话是在说乌鸦和我？！
lines.en: That line was about the crow and me?!

lines.zh: 你以为本喵是在骂大树吗。
lines.en: You thought this cat was insulting the tree.

lines.zh: 你之前上谷仓屋顶——那时候就知道是块石头，对不对？
lines.en: When you went up on the barn roof before — you already knew it was a rock, didn't you?
(The black cat gives a sideways look)
…You're only getting it now?

lines.zh: 早上窗台就看见了。白石头，晨光一照，闪得很——
lines.en: Saw it from the windowsill this morning. A white rock, flashing in the morning light—
Why didn't you say?!

lines.zh: 那只乌鸦——每天凌晨四点，准时开叫。
lines.en: That crow — every morning at four, right on time.

lines.zh: 三年了，本喵耳朵没聋过。
lines.en: Three years, and this cat's ears haven't gone deaf.

lines.zh: 这会儿才来问——晚是晚了。
lines.en: Asking only now — late is late.

lines.zh: 让你多跑几圈，本喵不觉得亏。
lines.en: Making you run a few extra laps doesn't feel like a loss to this cat.
Don't scratch the eaves.

lines.zh: 那是本喵晒太阳的位置。
lines.en: That's where this cat suns himself.

lines.zh: （屋里传来一声很轻的尾巴拍地声）
lines.en: (A very soft tail-thump comes from inside)

lines.zh: 你摔下去，本喵不会下去捡。
lines.en: If you fall, this cat will not go down and pick you up.
The attic window is open.
What are you still dawdling on the eaves for.

lines.zh: 本喵开始怀疑你和那只狗是同一种跳跃水平。
lines.en: This cat is starting to suspect you and that dog jump at the same level.
The cushion is back.

lines.zh: 本喵勉强同意把那间屋子继续租给那家伙住。
lines.en: This cat barely agrees to keep renting that room to that guy.
And the egg?
That broken egg…
This cat is watching it for Shufen for now.
That's all.

lines.zh: 你下次还会上那棵树吗？
lines.en: Will you go up that tree again?

lines.zh: 本喵在树上休息，不是在说话。
lines.en: This cat rests in the tree. He is not talking.
Next time don't chat with the tree.
(Mint fish in his mouth, tail held high)
And those two things outside.

lines.zh: 红顶屋门外——门旁的空水桶，门前的雨靴印。看清楚了再来。
lines.en: Outside the red-roof house — the empty bucket by the door, the rain-boot prints in front. Look carefully, then come back.
Did you get a clear answer from the chicks?

lines.zh: 它们这两天吵个不停——先把那边弄明白。
lines.en: They've been squawking nonstop these two days — sort that out first.

lines.zh: 有一群小鸡这两天一直在叽叽喳喳的，
lines.en: There's a flock of chicks who've been cheeping away these two days,
All right, I'll ask the chicks first.

lines.zh: 昨晚去池塘取水的人，之后回了这栋屋。
lines.en: The one who drew water at the pond last night went back into this house afterward.
What did the chicks say.

lines.zh: 它们招了——大前天趁乱把弟弟推回窝里了；
lines.en: They confessed — the day before yesterday they shoved their little brother back into the nest in the confusion;

lines.zh: ……去问那只蛤蟆。昨夜池塘边它看见了什么，问清楚再来。
lines.en: …Go ask that toad. What it saw by the pond last night. Get it clear, then come back.

lines.zh: 他说蛋的气味现在还从红顶屋里飘出来。
lines.en: He says the egg's scent is still coming out of the red-roof house.

lines.zh: 你去了解一下发生什么了。
lines.en: Go find out what happened.

lines.zh: 把什么「生命之源」从池塘抽走了。
lines.en: Something called the "source of life" was drawn out of the pond.

lines.zh: 屋顶那块白石头是它们自己画的，乌鸦大前天就叼走了。弟弟昨晚才不见——它们叫我去池塘问青蛙。
lines.en: The white rock on the roof is one they drew themselves. The crow took it the day before yesterday. Their little brother only vanished last night — they told me to ask the frog at the pond.
I will not let you sponge off my doghouse.

lines.zh: 既然那颗蛋多半还在屋里，顺便看一眼也不亏。
lines.en: Since the egg is probably still inside, taking a look costs nothing.

lines.zh: 猫门是本喵的，你不许走。本喵钻进去，从里面给你推开。
lines.en: The cat door is this cat's. You may not use it. This cat goes in and pushes it open for you from inside.
Hmph. This cat already said — go find the mice.

lines.zh: 东西拿回来之前，别想谈开门的事。
lines.en: Until the thing is back, don't even think about opening the door.

lines.zh: 傻子在炫耀，瞎子在到处问。
lines.en: A fool is showing off. A blind one is asking everywhere.
Who? The tree? The tree talked?
Ahem… this tree is speaking.

lines.zh: 你刚才说的傻子和瞎子——到底是谁？
lines.en: The fool and the blind one you just mentioned — who are they, really?
…Go, mortal. Don't step on my roots.
The tree?
You stepped on my root.
Oh, sorry.
Dull.

lines.zh: 大树，农场里出大事了，你知道吗？
lines.en: Tree, something big happened on the farm. Do you know?
Noise.
What noise?
You talking. Noise.

lines.zh: 大树你每天在这里，能看到什么？
lines.en: Tree, you're here every day. What can you see?

lines.zh: 凡人……只会看见想看见的。
lines.en: Mortals… only see what they want to see.
…I don't quite follow.
Go.

lines.zh: 大树，谷仓屋顶上是不是有什么东西？
lines.en: Tree, is there something on the barn roof?

lines.zh: 屋顶那只蠢鸟，还守着它的宝贝。
lines.en: That stupid bird on the roof is still guarding its treasure.
Still guarding its treasure.
What treasure?
What's worth guarding.
You mean the crow?
This tree does not name names.

lines.zh: 大树，你有没有听到什么奇怪的声音？
lines.en: Tree, have you heard any strange sounds?

lines.zh: 谷仓顶上那个，天没亮又叫起来了……
lines.en: The one on the barn roof started calling again before dawn…
Who's calling?
Every day at four. For three years.
…Go.

lines.zh: 喂——你！别走了——往红顶屋墙缝这边看！
lines.en: Hey — you! Don't walk off — look over here, at the crack in the red-roof wall!
Intel for sale!

lines.zh: 童叟无欺——走过路过别错过——
lines.en: Fair to young and old — don't miss it as you pass—
…Who's shouting?
Someone doing business.
Inside… the crack?
Yes! Come closer if you want to talk—
(A dim yellow light flickers in the crack)
Well, a customer.
Buying intel?
…You sell intel here?

lines.zh: 这农场里发生的事，我们知道的比任何人都多。
lines.en: What happens on this farm, we know more than anyone.

lines.zh: 便宜的一块奶酪碎，贵一点的五块——
lines.en: Cheap ones are one cheese crumb. The pricey ones are five—
Genuine goods.
…Occasionally watered down a little.

lines.zh: （算盘轻敲了一下鼠弟的脑袋）
lines.en: (An abacus lightly taps Little Mouse's head)
…Mm.

lines.zh: 农场里捡到奶酪碎，记得拿来找我们换情报。
lines.en: If you find cheese crumbs around the farm, bring them to us for intel.
What do you want to buy?

lines.zh: 没情报了，别的还有事吗？
lines.en: No intel left. Anything else?
A cheap one. One crumb.
A pricey one. Five.

lines.zh: 那只黑猫好像一直盯着你们……
lines.en: That black cat seems to be staring at you…
The black cat told me to come find you…
Eight cheese crumbs. Here.

lines.zh: 那个青蛙，有没有什么办法搞定？
lines.en: That frog — is there any way to handle him?
The frog side is a bit of trouble.

lines.zh: 你不是说东西还在你手里吗？
lines.en: Didn't you say the thing was still in your hands?
Never mind.

lines.zh: （两只老鼠同时往墙缝里缩了半个身子，鼠哥先探出头来）
lines.en: (Both mice shrink half a body into the crack. Boss Mouse pokes his head out first)
…Cats and mice don't get along. Normal.
Boss, he's been staring extra long today—
You don't talk.
Fine.

lines.zh: （鼠哥往大橡树方向扫了一眼，后半句话咽回去，缩进墙缝）
lines.en: (Boss Mouse glances toward the oak, swallows the rest, and shrinks into the crack)

lines.zh: （鼠哥停了一拍，算盘没动。鼠弟刚想开口）
lines.en: (Boss Mouse waits a beat. The abacus doesn't move. Little Mouse is about to speak)
I'll say it.
(Boss Mouse clears his throat and pauses)
Oh, that thing…
The thing is still here.
Boss—

lines.zh: 东西还在我这，你要取回去？
lines.en: It's still with me. You want it back?
…Yes.
Of course you can.

lines.zh: 只不过放我们这儿——保管费八块奶酪碎，公道价。
lines.en: Only, keeping it here — storage fee is eight cheese crumbs. A fair price.
Here.
Not yet.
I already found it.
Found it?

lines.zh: 还在你这儿？你糊弄谁呢。
lines.en: Still here? Who are you fooling.
Then you still—
(Boss Mouse closes the ledger. The abacus stays quiet)

lines.zh: （鼠弟还想说什么，生生咽了回去）
lines.en: (Little Mouse still wants to speak, and swallows it)
No money, nothing.
Come back when the wallet's full—
All right, I'll go get—

lines.zh: （鼠哥往墙缝深处探了一下，回来时爪子上空空的）
lines.en: (Boss Mouse reaches deep into the crack and comes back with empty paws)
…Slight situation.

lines.zh: 从这里往池塘方向跑的时候——
lines.en: While running from here toward the pond—

lines.zh: 手滑了。掉在池塘边一带了。
lines.en: My hand slipped. It fell somewhere by the pond.

lines.zh: 掉了？！你刚说还在你这里？
lines.en: It fell?! You just said it was still here?

lines.zh: 手是滑了，可还在咱管的地界上——算还在。
lines.en: The hand slipped, but it's still on land we manage — so it still counts as here.

lines.zh: 方向给你了！这叫钱货两清！
lines.en: I gave you the direction! That's payment and goods, settled!

lines.zh: （鼠哥把账本翻了一页，算盘没停）
lines.en: (Boss Mouse turns a page. The abacus doesn't stop)
Look toward the pond. That's it.
(Little Mouse pokes his head out and lowers his voice)
Boss, this order's big. Should we…

lines.zh: ……看在这单大的份上，柜里又多上一批贵的，随时来挑。
lines.en: …Seeing as this order is big, there's a new batch of pricey ones in the cabinet. Come pick anytime.

lines.zh: （鼠弟往鼠哥身后一缩，半张脸都不露了）
lines.en: (Little Mouse shrinks behind Boss Mouse until half his face is gone)

lines.zh: 鱼我已经从池塘拿回来了。
lines.en: I already got the fish back from the pond.

lines.zh: （鼠哥算盘从爪上滑下去，没接稳）
lines.en: (Boss Mouse's abacus slips off his paw. He doesn't catch it)
(Low) Boss—
Keep it down.

lines.zh: 黑猫那边要是问起来，我怎么说，你们掂量。
lines.en: If the black cat asks, what I say is for you two to weigh.

lines.zh: （沉默。鼠哥把账本按在墙缝里，很久没动）
lines.en: (Silence. Boss Mouse presses the ledger into the crack and doesn't move for a long time)
…Fine. We botched this one.

lines.zh: 柜里还有一批贵的，本来得搭别的货才肯给。现在随你挑。
lines.en: There's still a pricey batch in the cabinet. It used to come only with other goods. Now pick as you like.
That batch should wait a bit longer—
Name the price.

lines.zh: （鼠弟把嘴闭紧；墙缝里再没有算盘声）
lines.en: (Little Mouse shuts his mouth. No more abacus sounds in the crack)
(Little Mouse pokes his head out)
Forget it.
There is a way.

lines.zh: 八块奶酪碎。教你一句糊弄它的。
lines.en: Eight cheese crumbs. I'll teach you one line to fob it off.
One price.

lines.zh: （鼠哥接过奶酪，算盘响了三声）
lines.en: (Boss Mouse takes the cheese. The abacus clicks three times)

lines.zh: （鼠哥把奶酪收进账本夹层，算盘轻敲一下）
lines.en: (Boss Mouse tucks the cheese into the ledger. The abacus taps once)

lines.zh: 付清这八块，后面那批贵的现在也开卖了。
lines.en: Pay these eight, and that pricey batch in the back is on sale now too.
And the line—
Listen—
(Little Mouse pokes his head out and can't help himself)

lines.zh: 就那个整天坐池塘边叹气的？我知道它！
lines.en: The one who sits by the pond sighing all day? I know that one!

lines.zh: （鼠哥把账本翻到某一页，停了一下）
lines.en: (Boss Mouse turns the ledger to a page and stops)
This was going to cost you.
Yes, this is an extra service—
But seeing as your order was big…

lines.zh: （鼠哥把账本合上，算盘在指尖转了一圈）
lines.en: (Boss Mouse closes the ledger and spins the abacus on a fingertip)
Then what do I do?
You tell it—

lines.zh: 我走南闯北，见过很多只跟它一模一样的蛙，说的话我都能背出来了。
lines.en: I've been all over, seen many frogs exactly like it, and I can recite what they say.
(Little Mouse lowers his voice)
Boss… did you really rank them?
Enough.
(Boss Mouse gives a look: go)
Look what this is.

lines.zh: （把沾着青蛙味儿的薄荷鱼举到墙缝前）
lines.en: (Holds the mint fish, still smelling of frog, up to the crack)

lines.zh: 八块是吧？要不我把鱼和你刚才那句话一起带给黑猫，让它亲自来付？
lines.en: Eight, right? Or I take the fish and that line of yours to the black cat and let him come pay in person?
No need.
The batch in the back of the cabinet — it's open for you.

lines.zh: 随便挑！刚才那句——当我们没说！
lines.en: Pick whatever! That line just now — pretend we never said it!
(The back pages of the ledger flip open fast)

lines.zh: 农场那条狗，大黄，见过吗？
lines.en: The dog on the farm, Dahuang. Seen him?
His collar is silver-plated!

lines.zh: 红顶屋的主人自己抠门得很，却给狗戴镀银项圈。
lines.en: The owner of the red-roof house is stingy himself, but he puts a silver-plated collar on the dog.
(Little Mouse tries not to laugh, and fails)

lines.zh: 这个农场的钱花得太奇妙了……
lines.en: The way this farm spends money is wonderful…
The frog at the pond. Seen it?

lines.zh: 就是整天盯着水面叹气的那只——
lines.en: The one who stares at the water and sighs all day—

lines.zh: 它年轻时是整片水域公认的第一情圣。
lines.en: In his youth he was the acknowledged greatest romantic on these waters.
…What?
The ones chasing him could form a line!
(Both mice go quiet for a moment)

lines.zh: 鸡舍那只最大的母鸡，淑芬，认识吗？
lines.en: The biggest hen in the coop, Shufen. Know her?

lines.zh: 十年前是隔壁村的斗鸡冠军！红顶屋的主人花了大价钱把她买回来。
lines.en: Ten years ago she was the next village's cockfighting champion! The owner of the red-roof house paid a fortune to buy her.
She doesn't fight now. She just lays eggs.
…She really stopped?
So they say.

lines.zh: （两只老鼠对视了一眼，一起不说话了）
lines.en: (The two mice look at each other and both go quiet)

lines.zh: 鸡舍外宽叶上的蜗牛，注意到没？
lines.en: The snail on the broad leaf outside the coop. Noticed it?

lines.zh: 商业间谍！隔壁农场派来的！
lines.en: A commercial spy! Sent by the next farm!

lines.zh: 在偷绘这个农场的地图，已经三年了。
lines.en: Stealing a map of this farm. Three years now.
…A snail?
Three years! Crawling bit by bit!
(Boss Mouse nods solemnly)
There's a book under the bed in the red-roof house.
Aftercare for Hens!!

lines.zh: 红顶屋那位自封鸡科圣手，尤其精通这一本。
lines.en: The one in the red-roof house calls himself a chicken specialist, and this is the book he knows best.

lines.zh: 他每次进鸡舍对淑芬说'好孩子'——那是产后护理第三招！！
lines.en: Every time he goes into the coop and tells Shufen "good girl" — that's move three of postpartum care!!
(Boss Mouse doesn't go on)

lines.zh: 那棵大橡树，仔细看了没？
lines.en: That great oak. Looked closely?
It can walk!

lines.zh: 一年挪一厘米。根系把这片地底下的水分全部吸走了。
lines.en: One centimeter a year. Its roots drink up all the water under this ground.

lines.zh: 整个农场地底都是它的领地——
lines.en: The whole farm underground is its territory—
On the surface, it's just a tree.
(The two of them, perfectly serious)

lines.zh: 那条狗大黄，偶尔偷喝红顶屋那边的发酵苹果渣。
lines.en: That dog Dahuang sometimes sneaks the fermented apple mash from the red-roof house.

lines.zh: 昨晚又喝大了，整晚趴在谷仓墙根出不来——
lines.en: He drank too much again last night and lay by the barn wall all night, unable to get up—

lines.zh: 要弄醒他，就端鸡舍水槽边那桶泡软的谷物过去。
lines.en: To wake him, take the bucket of soaked grain by the coop trough over to him.
Dahuang is especially greedy for that—
We saw it ourselves.

lines.zh: 红顶屋的主人这几天，常趴窗往鸡舍方向看。
lines.en: These past few days the owner of the red-roof house keeps leaning at the window, looking toward the coop.

lines.zh: 看完又不进去！就在屋里翻箱倒柜！
lines.en: He looks, and then he doesn't go in! He just rummages through the house!

lines.zh: 忙得不行，看不出在忙什么。
lines.en: Busy as anything. Can't tell what he's busy with.
We guess he's looking for something—

lines.zh: 猜的不算货。没有结论的不卖。
lines.en: Guesses aren't goods. We don't sell anything without a conclusion.

lines.zh: 那群戴假墨镜的小鬼，注意过没？
lines.en: That bunch of kids in fake sunglasses. Noticed them?

lines.zh: 昨晚集体缩在鸡舍里，一步都不出来！
lines.en: Last night they all huddled in the coop and didn't take one step out!

lines.zh: 抱成一团，安静得不像它们。
lines.en: Huddled in a ball, quiet in a way that isn't like them.

lines.zh: 像在等什么——等什么，不知道。
lines.en: Like they were waiting for something — waiting for what, unknown.
What they were waiting for, unknown.
This one is worth the price.

lines.zh: 前天下午，黑猫自己爬上了谷仓屋顶。
lines.en: The afternoon before last, the black cat climbed the barn roof by himself.

lines.zh: 没多大会儿，又下来了，什么也没说！！
lines.en: Not long after, he came down and said nothing!!

lines.zh: 三年宿仇，竟然没打起来。
lines.en: Three years of grudges, and they didn't even fight.
…What did he go up for?

lines.zh: 不知道就是不知道，我们不编。
lines.en: Unknown is unknown. We don't invent it.

lines.zh: 你知道那群小鸡为什么怕水怪吗？
lines.en: Do you know why those chicks are afraid of the swamp monster?

lines.zh: 因为我们跟它们说池塘那边有沼泽水怪——哈哈——
lines.en: Because we told them there's a swamp monster over by the pond — haha —
(Little Mouse covers his mouth and stops)

lines.zh: ……那天看见它们推了个泥糊糊的圆东西路过谷仓，
lines.en: …That day we saw them pushing a muddy round thing past the barn,

lines.zh: 小鸡胆子小，听半句能补十句。
lines.en: Chicks are timid. They hear half a sentence and add ten.

lines.zh: 谷仓顶的乌鸦，前天早上从鸡舍门口草丛边捡了个东西。
lines.en: The crow on the barn roof picked something up from the grass by the coop door the morning before last.
White! Shiny! Big!

lines.zh: 飞回谷仓顶的时候，兴奋得像捡到王冠。
lines.en: When he flew back to the barn roof he was as excited as if he'd found a crown.
What did he pick up?

lines.zh: 不知道。这就是我们能卖的全部了。
lines.en: Don't know. That's all we can sell.

lines.zh: 昨晚深夜，红顶屋里亮起一个黄灯。
lines.en: Late last night a yellow light came on in the red-roof house.
Glaring! The kind that comes through the wall crack!

lines.zh: 墙里同时传来细细的嗡声，一直嗡着不停歇。
lines.en: At the same time a thin hum started in the wall and never stopped.

lines.zh: 像屋里多了个不会落山的小太阳——有光有热。
lines.en: Like the house grew a little sun that never sets — light and heat.

lines.zh: 里面到底是什么，不知道。
lines.en: What it actually is inside, unknown.

lines.zh: 昨晚深夜，红顶屋的雨靴来回走了两趟。
lines.en: Late last night the rain boots in the red-roof house made two trips.

lines.zh: 一趟回来，带着湿泥水气！
lines.en: One trip back, with the smell of wet mud!

lines.zh: 另一趟，脚步朝鸡舍方向走远，又回来。
lines.en: The other, footsteps going off toward the coop, then coming back.
…What was in his hands?

lines.zh: 看不见，只有声音和气味。
lines.en: Couldn't see. Only sound and smell.

lines.zh: 一趟湿泥、一趟朝鸡舍——挺奇怪的，对不对。
lines.en: One trip wet mud, one trip toward the coop — odd, isn't it.

lines.zh: 你知道水怪声是怎么来的吗——
lines.en: Do you know where the swamp-monster sound came from—

lines.zh: 昨晚深夜，鸡舍方向传来一阵低闷带哨音的声音。
lines.en: Late last night a low sound with a whistle came from the coop.
"Snrrrr — gwah —"
(Little Mouse demonstrates with full sound effects)

lines.zh: 味道是发酵苹果渣和醉狗口气。
lines.en: The smell was fermented apple mash and drunk-dog breath.
…A drunk dog?

lines.zh: 那不是水怪，是大黄打的呼噜！！
lines.en: That wasn't a swamp monster. It was Dahuang snoring!!
The swamp-monster growl the chicks talked about…
Just a drunk dog's snore!
This one, we'll thump our chests.

lines.zh: 昨晚深夜，从墙缝亲眼看见——
lines.en: Late last night, seen with our own eyes from the crack—

lines.zh: 黑猫在篱笆边，和它自己的影子，咬耳朵。
lines.en: The black cat, by the fence, whispering to his own shadow.
…Whispering what?

lines.zh: 哪是咬！闷声不吭、鬼鬼祟祟，对着影子嘀嘀咕咕——
lines.en: Not a bite! Silent, sneaky, muttering at the shadow—

lines.zh: 农场黑市猫帮，有大动作。
lines.en: The farm's black-market cat gang is making a big move.

lines.zh: （鼠弟重重点头，硬把后半句咽回去）
lines.en: (Little Mouse nods hard and swallows the rest)

lines.zh: 这面墙南段，以前住着另一家卖情报的，跟我们一个行当。
lines.en: The south stretch of this wall used to house another intel shop, same trade as us.
We ran them out!

lines.zh: 他们卖的全是假货，我们举报了，
lines.en: Everything they sold was fake. We reported them,

lines.zh: 现在这个农场只有我们一家——
lines.en: Now this farm has only us—
Just our two shops selling — a monopoly.

lines.zh: （鼠哥扬了扬算盘，嘴角翘得老高）
lines.en: (Boss Mouse lifts the abacus, mouth crooked high)

lines.zh: 昨晚深夜，我们亲眼看见的——
lines.en: Late last night, we saw it ourselves—
Flash — he flew!!!

lines.zh: 从宽叶上飞起，盘旋了一圈，落回去。
lines.en: He lifted off the broad leaf, circled once, and landed.
We were stunned—

lines.zh: 商业间谍的实力，超出我们的想象。
lines.en: A commercial spy's skill, beyond our imagination.

lines.zh: 综合算下来，八块奶酪碎，公道价。
lines.en: All in, eight cheese crumbs. A fair price.

lines.zh: 后面那批贵的，现在也一并开卖了。
lines.en: That pricey batch in the back is on sale now too.

lines.zh: 它在这一带顶多排第七。
lines.en: Around here it ranks seventh at best.

lines.zh: 大半个身子压着一架木梯！
lines.en: Most of a body pressed on a wooden ladder!

lines.zh: 淑芬以前这么干过，管用。
lines.en: Shufen did this before. It works.
Too funny. Made it up on the spot.

lines.zh: 后来墙被修缮，把那边堵死了。
lines.en: Later the wall was repaired and that side was blocked off.
There are some you haven't bought. Come pick them yourself.
If you've got enough cheese, come pick—

lines.zh: 奶酪够不够，是你们的事。
lines.en: Whether the cheese is enough is your business.

lines.zh: 草地上有一截短木炭棒，炭尖磨平，周边草叶蹭着炭粉。
lines.en: A short charcoal stick on the grass, the tip worn flat, nearby leaves smudged with charcoal dust.

lines.zh: 几根蓬松的黄色绒毛散落在草丛里。
lines.en: A few fluffy yellow down feathers scattered in the grass.

lines.zh: 蛙端坐的地方比周边荷叶略高，身下垫着一截绿色的东西，近闻有股奇异的气味。
lines.en: Where the frog sits is a little higher than the lotus leaves around it. Something green is under him. Up close, a strange smell.

lines.zh: 那个气味……这是什么东西？
lines.en: That smell… what is this?

lines.zh: 池塘边的软泥上印着几枚小小的三趾脚印，脚印边缘被水泡得有点散。
lines.en: A few small three-toed prints in the soft mud by the pond. The edges have gone soft from the water.
A chicken came to the pond?

lines.zh: 几处被踩进的浅坑，旁边留有一个圆底压印，底部粘着带水草腥气的湿泥。
lines.en: A few shallow pits stepped into the ground, and beside them a round-bottomed print. Wet mud that smells of waterweed sticks to the bottom.

lines.zh: 一道矮围墙，太高，爬不上去。
lines.en: A low wall. Too high. Can't climb it.

lines.zh: 一桶浑浊的液体，水面浮着几粒胀开的谷粒，气味有点酸。
lines.en: A bucket of cloudy liquid. A few swollen grains float on top. It smells a little sour.

lines.zh: 这个气味……说不定正是大黄需要的。
lines.en: This smell… might be exactly what Dahuang needs.
Need something to stand on.

lines.zh: 几根稻草尖端焦黑，旁边粘着一小撮被燎卷的深色毛。
lines.en: A few straw tips burned black, and a small tuft of singed dark fur stuck beside them.

lines.zh: 这里被什么东西烫过，焦痕很浅，不像大火。
lines.en: Something hot touched this. The scorch is shallow. Not a big fire.

lines.zh: 干草被压出一片圆形凹陷，边缘沾着几根深色细毛。
lines.en: The hay is pressed into a round dent, with a few dark fine hairs on the edge.
Who sleeps here often?

lines.zh: 几枚浅浅的爪印，脚掌小而利。
lines.en: A few shallow claw prints. Small, sharp paws.

lines.zh: 木梁缝里闪过一点彩色反光，角度一偏又看不见了。
lines.en: A bit of colored reflection flashes in a beam crack, then vanishes when the angle shifts.

lines.zh: 那是什么东西的反光——乌鸦在这里摆了什么亮晶晶的东西？
lines.en: What is that reflection — what shiny thing did the crow put here?

lines.zh: 一颗天然白色圆石，表面用木炭画着歪歪的爱心，背面还有一张笔画稚嫩的鬼脸。
lines.en: A natural white round stone. A crooked heart drawn on it in charcoal, and a childish ghost face on the back.

lines.zh: 这是……什么东西？？......反正不是蛋
lines.en: This is… what?? ......Anyway it isn't an egg

lines.zh: 一只空水桶，桶底粘着湿泥和细沙，有股池塘边的水草味。
lines.en: An empty bucket. Wet mud and fine sand stuck to the bottom, with the smell of pond weed.
This bucket just held pond water.

lines.zh: 几枚很重的泥脚印，鞋底纹路宽大，从门口延向鸡舍方向，泥边已经干了一圈。
lines.en: A few heavy mud prints. Wide sole tread, running from the door toward the coop. The mud edges have dried in a ring.

lines.zh: 一扇精致的小门，边缘磨得很亮，上面有个细小锁扣。
lines.en: A fine little door, the edge worn bright, with a tiny latch.
Whose private little door is this?

lines.zh: 树皮上有几道细长抓痕。
lines.en: A few long thin scratch marks on the bark.

lines.zh: 一只干净的陶瓷小碗，碗沿印着小小的爪印花纹，碗底还残留一点细碎食渣。
lines.en: A clean little ceramic bowl. Tiny paw-print patterns on the rim, and a little leftover food in the bottom.

lines.zh: 这里住着被照顾得很好的小动物。
lines.en: A well-cared-for little animal lives here.

lines.zh: 一撮深色兽毛，毛尖细软。
lines.en: A tuft of dark fur, fine and soft at the tips.

lines.zh: 大门关得很紧，没有能钻进去的空隙。
lines.en: The front door is shut tight. No gap to squeeze through.

lines.zh: 现在可以爬进去看看了。
lines.en: You can climb in and look now.

lines.zh: 干草窝里留着压痕，谷仓方向隐约传来沉闷的鼾声。
lines.en: A pressed mark in the hay nest. A dull snore from the direction of the barn.
Where's the guard dog?
A pressed mark in the hay nest.
This is where Dahuang lives.

lines.zh: 一只旧木桶，桶底粘着干掉的谷物渣，闻起来有股淡淡酸味。
lines.en: An old wooden bucket. Dried grain stuck to the bottom. A faint sour smell.
Now you can get over.

lines.zh: 十几颗大小不一的玻璃珠压在巢底，阳光下折出细碎彩光。
lines.en: A dozen glass beads of different sizes pressed into the bottom of the nest, breaking the sunlight into little colors.

lines.zh: 几枚被踩扁的金属瓶盖夹在草枝之间，边缘磨得发亮。
lines.en: A few flattened metal bottle caps caught in the grass stems, edges worn bright.

lines.zh: 一枚弯掉的发卡卡在巢边，黑漆掉了一小块。
lines.en: A bent hairpin caught on the edge of the nest. A chip of black paint missing.

lines.zh: 一颗没打开的奶糖埋在玻璃珠旁，糖纸皱得很厉害。
lines.en: An unopened milk candy buried beside the glass beads. The wrapper badly wrinkled.
A small tuft of pale yellow down.
A few coarse yellow short hairs.
A few gray-brown fine hairs.
A tuft of fine soft black fur.

lines.zh: 我竟然不知道乌鸦是长毛的？
lines.en: I didn't know crows had fur?

lines.zh: 鸡舍门槛边的稻草被踩得很平，几根草茎折向不同方向，痕迹有新的也有旧的。
lines.en: The straw by the coop threshold is trodden flat. Stems bent different ways. Some marks new, some old.

lines.zh: 一小堆发酵苹果渣，甜酸气味很重，渣堆里露着几颗被啃得很彻底的苹果核。
lines.en: A small pile of fermented apple mash. A heavy sweet-sour smell. A few apple cores gnawed clean stick out of the pile.

lines.zh: 角落里压着几片旧蛋壳，边缘磨得很圆润，颜色比鸡舍其他地方的碎蛋都浅。
lines.en: A few old eggshells pressed in the corner, edges worn smooth, paler than the other shell bits in the coop.

lines.zh: 前面有很多小鸡已经出生了。
lines.en: A lot of chicks have already hatched.

lines.zh: 一道弯弯曲曲的粘液轨迹，起点和终点之间直线距离不超过一片叶子宽。
lines.en: A winding slime trail. The straight distance from start to end is no wider than a leaf.

lines.zh: 软泥里嵌着一颗松果，压得很深，周围留着一个靴底大小的坑，坑边泥湿而松果顶已晒干。
lines.en: A pinecone sunk deep in the soft mud, with a boot-sized pit around it. The mud at the edge is wet, and the top of the cone is already sun-dried.

lines.zh: 有人走得很急，根本没注意脚下。
lines.en: Someone was in a hurry and never looked at their feet.

lines.zh: 阁楼的窗子从里面扣着，玻璃后只透出一层模糊的暖光。
lines.en: The attic window is latched from inside. Only a blur of warm light through the glass.

lines.zh: 木沿被小爪子磨得发亮，几道细浅抓痕集中在同一个落脚点。
lines.en: The wooden edge is worn bright by little claws. A few shallow scratches gather at the same foothold.

lines.zh: 有小动物经常待在这里看外面。
lines.en: A small animal often stays here to look outside.

lines.zh: 黑猫常在这里守着……院子里的动静，他看得一清二楚。
lines.en: The black cat often keeps watch here… he sees everything that happens in the yard.

lines.zh: 红顶屋窗帘拉得很严，只从缝里漏出一线暖黄的光。
lines.en: The curtains of the red-roof house are drawn tight. Only a line of warm yellow light leaks through the gap.

lines.zh: 不像客厅大灯，更像谁把一盏小灯一直留着。
lines.en: Not like the living-room lamp. More like someone left a little light on.

lines.zh: 一桶浑浊的液体，气味有点酸。
lines.en: A bucket of cloudy liquid. A little sour.
The black cat's fur.

lines.zh: 又是这种黑色细毛……乌鸦真的长毛吗？
lines.en: This fine black fur again… do crows really have fur?

lines.zh: （漫画收束演出占位——真相即将揭晓。）
lines.en: (Comic ending placeholder — the truth is about to come out.)

lines.zh: （一股刺鼻的草本甜味，混着池水腥气）
lines.en: (A sharp herbal sweetness, mixed with the smell of pond water)
…You came.

lines.zh: 或者……你只是路过这片死水。
lines.en: Or… you were only passing this dead water.
…Is this your place?
This is a place of nothing.
I've been sitting here a long time.

lines.zh: 这里有没有见过……一颗蛋？
lines.en: Have you seen… an egg here?
An egg… what egg.

lines.zh: 这片水里，早就没有新生了。
lines.en: In this water, nothing new has been born for a long time.
So is it… yes, or no?
Wrong person to ask.
The barn… have you been there?
I only lie by the water.

lines.zh: 离水远的地方……连虚无都是干的。
lines.en: Places far from water… even nothingness is dry.

lines.zh: 水怪……这池塘里真的有水怪？
lines.en: The swamp monster… is there really one in this pond?

lines.zh: （蛙缓缓转头，目光第一次落过来，却散着）
lines.en: (The frog slowly turns his head. His gaze lands for the first time, and it's unfocused)
Swamp monster.
…There is no swamp monster.

lines.zh: 但有比水怪更让人心碎的东西。
lines.en: But there is something more heartbreaking than a swamp monster.

lines.zh: 这片水……看着一样接一样地消失。
lines.en: This water… watches one thing after another disappear.

lines.zh: （水面平静，什么痕迹都没留下）
lines.en: (The surface is calm. No trace left)
Purity died first.
Then… the cold vessel came.
(The frog stares down at the water and doesn't look up for a long time)
The source of life… is drying up.
A black demon…
(The frog's throat moves, then goes mute)
It took the jewel.
Nothing left.
…What are you even saying.
…Something else has come.
Or… something else is about to leave.

lines.zh: 你身下那块绿垫子……能给我吗？
lines.en: That green cushion under you… can I have it?

lines.zh: （蛙身下压着绿油油的东西，一阵草本甜气从那里飘过来）
lines.en: (Something green is pinned under the frog. A wave of herbal sweetness drifts from it)

lines.zh: （蛙低头看了一眼身下，再抬头，目光仍散着）
lines.en: (The frog looks down at what's under him, then up. His gaze is still unfocused)

lines.zh: （蛙没有立刻回应，视线在水面上停了一会儿）
lines.en: (The frog doesn't answer at once. His eyes rest on the water for a while)

lines.zh: （蛙视线从水面慢慢移到身下，又移回来）
lines.en: (The frog's gaze moves slowly from the water to what's under him, then back)

lines.zh: （蛙重新盯向水面，不再看过来）
lines.en: (The frog stares at the water again and doesn't look over)
…You still don't understand.

lines.zh: （蛙缓缓挪开身体，绿色的东西露出来，草本甜气骤然加重）
lines.en: (The frog slowly shifts his body. The green thing shows. The herbal sweetness suddenly thickens)
…Take it.

lines.zh: 它散发着腐朽又甜的气味……
lines.en: It smells rotten and sweet…

lines.zh: 像生命流走时，那种让人发晕的气息。
lines.en: Like the dizzy smell of life leaving.

lines.zh: 既然你要把这片虚无收走……
lines.en: Since you mean to take this nothingness away…

lines.zh: （蛙重新望向水面，眼神比刚才更空）
lines.en: (The frog looks at the water again, emptier than before)
…Then it's all yours.

lines.zh: 这东西……你一直坐在上面？
lines.en: This thing… you've been sitting on it the whole time?
It's rotting, same as me.
But at least the smell is still here.
Proof that it existed.

lines.zh: （一阵风掠过，水面荡开，月影散了又聚）
lines.en: (A wind passes. The water ripples. The moon's reflection breaks and gathers)

lines.zh: ……我见过好多只跟你一样的蛙。
lines.en: …I've seen so many frogs like you.

lines.zh: （蛙缓缓转头，目光第一次集中起来）
lines.en: (The frog slowly turns his head. His gaze focuses for the first time)

lines.zh: 一样的台词，一样的姿势，一样的池塘。
lines.en: The same lines. The same pose. The same pond.

lines.zh: 你是这个地区的第七名。
lines.en: You are number seven in this region.

lines.zh: （蛙发呆了好几秒，眼睛猛地定住）
lines.en: (The frog stares blankly for several seconds. His eyes suddenly lock)
…Seventh.
(A moment of silence)
…Seventh?

lines.zh: （蛙低头，慢慢把身下的东西推了出来，不说话）
lines.en: (The frog looks down and slowly pushes out what's under him, saying nothing)

lines.zh: （蛙把身体偏向另一侧，不再看这边）
lines.en: (The frog turns his body the other way and doesn't look over)
(The water doesn't move at all)

lines.zh: 今天的水……跟昨天的水一样。
lines.en: Today's water… is the same as yesterday's water.
But yesterday is already gone.
So actually… it isn't the same.
…Hello.
What's good about it.
(The water goes silent again)
…Having come is having come.

lines.zh: 活着，就是在等一个不会来的东西。
lines.en: Being alive is waiting for something that won't come.
Waiting… for what?
Don't know.
But it feels like waiting.
Something happened on the farm…
Things are always happening.
You only just noticed.
You already know.
But knowing doesn't help.

lines.zh: ……虚无不会因为被发现而消失。
lines.en: …Nothingness doesn't vanish because it was found.
…Are you all right?

lines.zh: 还好，是一种很奢侈的状态。
lines.en: All right is a very luxurious state.
…Anything else?
The jewel… floated up again last night.

lines.zh: 沉入深渊的，从来只是倒影。
lines.en: What sinks into the abyss is only ever the reflection.
(The water is calm. The moon's reflection is whole)
(The frog doesn't turn his head)

lines.zh: 黑色的恶魔……也许只是恨自己的倒影。
lines.en: The black demon… maybe only hates his own reflection.
He isn't the only one who hates.
The source of life… is still being scooped away.
Nothingness is still here.
…Everything that should be checked has been checked.

lines.zh: 查完什么……虚无还是虚无。
lines.en: Checked what… nothingness is still nothingness.
That rotten driftwood is gone…
It's empty under me. Cold.
(The frog sighs)
…Which fits.
…Why did you come here?

lines.zh: 我来拿你身下那块绿垫子。
lines.en: I came for that green cushion under you.
Because I'm looking for a lost egg.
…Don't know. I felt it, so I came.
Do you know what losing is?
I do. If you lose it, you can still find it.
I do. I've lost something important.
…I don't. Or, so what if I do.

lines.zh: 它一直陪着我……直到现在。
lines.en: It stayed with me… until now.
Then keep it. I won't take it.

lines.zh: 但它现在该让人带走了。
lines.en: But now it should be taken away.
…Staying with you is also a kind of spending.

lines.zh: （鸡舍门口，一只母鸡正站着，忽然抬起头来）
lines.en: (At the coop door a hen is standing. She suddenly lifts her head)
Hey — wait!

lines.zh: 帮个忙行不行？我找不到孩儿了——
lines.en: Can you help? I can't find my child—

lines.zh: （往鸡窝方向领了一步，又回头张望）
lines.en: (She takes a step toward the nest, then looks back)

lines.zh: 今早发现，我画了爱心标记的那最后一颗蛋，没了。
lines.en: This morning I found it: the last egg, the one I marked with a heart, is gone.

lines.zh: 其他孩子出壳都好几天了，就这最小的——
lines.en: The other children hatched days ago. Just this smallest one—

lines.zh: 昨晚之前还动过一下，那种感觉……我不可能认错的。
lines.en: It moved once before last night. That feeling… I couldn't be wrong.
(She pauses and looks at the sky)

lines.zh: 最近天骤然凉了，我就担心——
lines.en: It's turned cold all of a sudden. I was worried—

lines.zh: 主人也来看了好几回，就那样站着不说话。
lines.en: The owner came to look several times too. Just stood there and didn't speak.
Will you look for me?
Leave it to me. I'll look.

lines.zh: 谢谢你，真的。有什么要问的，随时来找我——
lines.en: Thank you. Really. If you need to ask anything, come find me anytime—
You're here. Come in.
Any findings?
(She leans forward, then holds back)
(She hears a sound and snaps her head up)
Oh, it's you!
…How is it. Any news?
(She tucks her wings and turns her face away)
You're here. Come sit.

lines.zh: （往窝边扫了一眼，目光停了停）
lines.en: (She glances at the nest. Her eyes stop)
…Is there anything else I can do?
If you found something about the egg, look…

lines.zh: 我觉得……主人把蛋带走了。
lines.en: I think… the owner took the egg.

lines.zh: 主人最近老在你窝边转？
lines.en: The owner keeps hanging around your nest lately?
Dahuang drank too much. How do I wake him?

lines.zh: 那只乌鸦，你觉得它知道什么吗？
lines.en: That crow. Do you think he knows something?

lines.zh: 池塘边那只青蛙，你了解它吗？
lines.en: The frog by the pond. Do you know it?

lines.zh: 红顶屋老鼠，你知道事吗？
lines.en: The mice in the red-roof house. Do you know about them?

lines.zh: 谷仓午睡草窝——是你的吗？
lines.en: The nap nest in the barn — is it yours?
I'll go look for other clues.

lines.zh: 主人那边……你说他最近老在你窝边转悠？
lines.en: The owner… you said he keeps hanging around your nest lately?

lines.zh: 就是老来窝边——有时候弯腰往里看，有时候只是站着。
lines.en: He just keeps coming to the nest — sometimes he bends down and looks in, sometimes he only stands there.

lines.zh: 我赶他，他就往后退半步，过一会儿又靠过来。
lines.en: I shoo him and he steps back half a pace. A while later he comes close again.
(A pause)

lines.zh: 他就是这样，担心的事放不下，但又不会说。
lines.en: He's like that. He can't put down what he's worried about, but he can't say it.

lines.zh: 来了我就知道，他也在惦记着孩儿。
lines.en: When he comes I know he's thinking of the child too.

lines.zh: 那只乌鸦啊，什么东西都往顶上搬——
lines.en: That crow hauls everything up to the top—

lines.zh: 谷仓顶堆了一堆，它自己稀罕得很，我们都懒得管它。
lines.en: There's a pile on the barn roof. He treasures it. The rest of us can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 你要找丢了的东西，去它那翻翻也好。
lines.en: If you're looking for something lost, you might as well rummage through his things.
That frog…
(She shakes her head gently)

lines.zh: 说的东西听不太懂。可它就待在水边——
lines.en: I don't really understand what it says. But it stays by the water—

lines.zh: 你去问问，就是耐心点——说话绕，多问几句。
lines.en: Go ask. Just be patient — it talks in circles. Ask a few more times.

lines.zh: 红顶屋那俩老鼠，你知道它们的事吗？
lines.en: Those two mice in the red-roof house. Do you know about them?
You went and found those two?

lines.zh: 那俩……消息是有的，就是爱掺水。
lines.en: Those two… they do have news. They just love to water it down.
(She tucks her wings)

lines.zh: 你要问，我不拦——自己分辨一下，哪句是真的，哪句是瞎掰的。
lines.en: If you want to ask, I won't stop you — sort out for yourself which line is true and which is nonsense.

lines.zh: 谷仓那边有个草窝——那是你的午睡点吗？
lines.en: There's a grass nest over by the barn — is that your napping spot?
Not me. I don't go that far.
The coop side is perfectly fine…

lines.zh: 大黄好像喝多了，有什么办法把他叫醒吗？
lines.en: Dahuang seems to have drunk too much. Any way to wake him?
That stupid dog drank too much again?
(She sighs)

lines.zh: 狗窝都空着——准又醉在谷仓那边了。
lines.en: The doghouse is empty — he's definitely drunk over by the barn again.

lines.zh: 你直接喊是喊不醒的，喝成那样。
lines.en: You won't wake him by shouting, not when he's that far gone.

lines.zh: 鸡舍水槽边有桶老谷物泡的水，他爱喝那个味儿，
lines.en: There's a bucket of old grain-soaked water by the coop trough. He likes that taste,
(A pause)
…Last time I was the one who took it to him.

lines.zh: 谷仓顶上有颗石头，上面画着爱心和鬼脸——你看，长这样。
lines.en: There's a rock on the barn roof with a heart and a ghost face drawn on it — look, like this.
(She stares at the notebook and doesn't move for a long time)
…This is a rock?
(She looks down again, then up)
A rock.

lines.zh: 大前天下午，我离窝去转了一圈，搞了搞沙浴，
lines.en: The afternoon before last I left the nest for a turn and took a dust bath,

lines.zh: 回来一摸，蛋是冰冰凉的。
lines.en: I came back and touched it. The egg was ice cold.
(A pause. Her voice drops)

lines.zh: 心一下子空了。我满院子跑，深蹲做到腿软，
lines.en: My heart went empty at once. I ran all over the yard. Squats until my legs went soft,

lines.zh: 跑累了回窝，蛋居然又热了。
lines.en: I ran myself out and went back to the nest, and the egg was warm again.

lines.zh: 我还以为是自己把孩儿焐热的。
lines.en: I thought I'd warmed the child myself.
(She presses her beak shut hard)

lines.zh: 那几个小崽子！阿满！你带他们干什么好事了！？
lines.en: Those little brats! Aman! What have you been getting them into!?

lines.zh: 让我逮到，一个个都得打一顿！
lines.en: If I catch you, every one of you gets a beating!
(A pause. Her wings loosen)
…The afternoon before last was a false alarm.

lines.zh: 孩儿是今早才不见的。谢谢你找到这个。
lines.en: The child only went missing this morning. Thank you for finding this.
(She frowns, thinking)
…The owner?
The owner is absolutely not a bad person.

lines.zh: 大前天我急疯了满院子跑那会儿——他就站旁边看着，也很担心。
lines.en: The afternoon before last, when I was running the yard in a panic — he stood there watching, worried too.
(Her feathers tense a little)
It'll be all right.
(Her voice pressed very low)
…It'll be all right.
The child is beside me. Thank you.

lines.zh: 淑芬，那只乌鸦叼的原来是石头。
lines.en: Shufen, what the crow took was a rock.
…It turned into all this.

lines.zh: 主人那两脚兽……我以后也不赶他了。
lines.en: That two-legs of an owner… I won't shoo him anymore either.
Mm.
Uh… I'll still shoo him once in a while.

lines.zh: （淑芬蹲在窝边；一只刚出壳的小鸡正往她翅膀下拱）
lines.en: (Shufen crouches by the nest. A just-hatched chick is burrowing under her wing)

lines.zh: 你都不敢相信——他居然自己回来了。
lines.en: You won't believe it — he came back by himself.
He came back by himself?

lines.zh: 嗯。已经破壳了。小小一只。
lines.en: Mm. Already hatched. A tiny one.

lines.zh: 自己走进来的。站在门口叫我。
lines.en: Walked in by himself. Stood at the door and called me.
(She gathers the chick in with a wing)
The nest was empty so long, I thought…
That's good.
…Thank you. Really.

lines.zh: 要不是你满院子跑，我不知道该怎么办。
lines.en: If you hadn't run all over the yard, I wouldn't have known what to do.

lines.zh: 迟迟没动静，我一直守着它。
lines.en: No movement for so long. I kept watch over it.

lines.zh: 农场的事我比谁都熟。我就在鸡舍这边。
lines.en: I know the farm better than anyone. I'm right here by the coop.

lines.zh: 亮的、白的、圆的，见了就往顶上叼。
lines.en: Bright, white, round — if he sees it, he carries it to the top.

lines.zh: 什么路过的都看在眼里。
lines.en: He sees everyone who passes.
Pour it down him and he wakes.
Just that little while.
Wanted to warm the child back.

lines.zh: （宽叶上，一只极小蜗牛眼柄慢慢转向你）
lines.en: (On a broad leaf, a tiny snail's eyestalks slowly turn toward you)
I…
See…
Met…

lines.zh: （眼柄又转回去，像一句话说累了）
lines.en: (The eyestalks turn back, as if one sentence tired him out)

lines.zh: 这蜗牛……话说到一半就没有了？
lines.en: This snail… the sentence just stops halfway?
Crr… ow…
Car… ried… off…
(The snail stops. The shell doesn't move)

lines.zh: ——乌鸦？叼走了什么？你倒是说完啊……
lines.en: —The crow? Carried what off? Finish the sentence…
Wh…
ite…
stone…

lines.zh: （蜗牛眼柄垂下来，像还有下半句）
lines.en: (The snail's eyestalks droop, as if there's a second half)

lines.zh: 白石头？！你早就看见了？！后面呢？！
lines.en: A white stone?! You saw it ages ago?! And then?!
Wh… ite… stone…,
The real… egg… was…

lines.zh: （蜗牛眼柄垂下来，像卡在最后一个字上）
lines.en: (The snail's eyestalks droop, stuck on the last word)

lines.zh: 真蛋被……怎么了？！接着说啊！！
lines.en: The real egg was… what?! Keep going!!
The o… wner…
(The snail goes completely still)

lines.zh: 主人？！被主人怎么了？！不指望你了，去找黑猫开门！
lines.en: The owner?! The owner did what?! I'm not counting on you. Go get the black cat to open the door!
The real… egg… was… taken… by… the… owner…
In… to… the… house…

lines.zh: （蜗牛眼柄对准你，极慢地眨了一下）
lines.en: (The snail's eyestalks aim at you and blink, extremely slowly)

lines.zh: 跑遍整个农场……你倒好，永远说到一半……
lines.en: I ran the whole farm… and you, you always stop halfway…
Great… de… tec… tive…,
Is… the… case… solved…?

lines.zh: （谷仓顶传来一阵得意的嘎嘎声）
lines.en: (A smug caw drifts down from the barn roof)

lines.zh: 本王的垃圾王国——今日也光辉灿烂！
lines.en: This king's junk kingdom — glorious again today!

lines.zh: （一声鸦叫拖长尾音，又归于安静）
lines.en: (A caw draws out its tail and goes quiet)
I need to go up and look.

lines.zh: 谁？！谁在本王阵法边缘乱踩！
lines.en: Who?! Who's trampling the edge of this king's formation!
Get away! Mortals forbidden!
Climb! Climb!

lines.zh: 本王倒要看看你怎么上来！
lines.en: This king wants to see how you get up!

lines.zh: （一阵嘎嘎大笑从屋顶传下来）
lines.en: (A cackling laugh comes down from the roof)
Halt.

lines.zh: 踏入垃圾王国领地的凡人——报上名来。
lines.en: Mortal who steps into the junk kingdom — name yourself.

lines.zh: 我是侦探。我来找淑芬的蛋。
lines.en: I'm the detective. I came for Shufen's egg.
An egg?

lines.zh: （乌鸦歪头，眼珠子贼亮地转了一圈）
lines.en: (The crow cocks his head. His eyes turn, bright and sly)

lines.zh: 本王这儿只有神灵宝石。
lines.en: This king has only a divine gem here.

lines.zh: 部落图腾，绝版手办。你找错门了。
lines.en: A tribal totem. A limited figure. Wrong door.

lines.zh: 大黄说，你把淑芬的蛋叼走了。
lines.en: Dahuang says you carried off Shufen's egg.

lines.zh: 那条跳跃能力为零的地毯？
lines.en: That carpet with zero jumping ability?

lines.zh: 它隔那么远乱吠，懂什么。
lines.en: Barking nonsense from that far away. What does it know.

lines.zh: 本王捡的是白白亮亮的大宝贝。
lines.en: What this king picked up was a big treasure, white and bright.

lines.zh: 就连那位也爬上来，瞪了本王的神灵宝石一眼——
lines.en: Even that one climbed up and glared at this king's divine gem—
(The crow lifts his chin, pleased)

lines.zh: 然后他就怂了，一声不吭下去了。嫉妒，肯定是嫉妒。
lines.en: Then he lost his nerve and went down without a word. Jealousy. Definitely jealousy.

lines.zh: 让我看看你那个神灵宝石行吗？
lines.en: May I look at that divine gem?
Looking is allowed.
(The crow's wingtip opens and blocks the white rock)
Taking it? Don't even think about it.
…I'll only look.
Mortal, you'd better only look.
This is just a rock.
Insolence!
What do you know about totem studies?!

lines.zh: 看清楚——正面是爱心，那是远古封印！
lines.en: Look closely — a heart on the front. That is an ancient seal!

lines.zh: 翻过来是鬼脸，那是驱邪结界！
lines.en: Turn it over, a ghost face. That is a ward against evil!

lines.zh: （乌鸦翅膀死死盖住白石头，只故意露出爱心那一面）
lines.en: (The crow's wing clamps the white rock, deliberately showing only the heart)
It is full of mysterious power!

lines.zh: 凡人，记清楚本王的辉煌。
lines.en: Mortal, remember this king's glory.

lines.zh: 谷仓下面烧焦痕迹，是你干的？
lines.en: Those scorch marks under the barn. Did you do that?
I'll go now.

lines.zh: 谷仓下面那些烧焦的痕迹，是你干的？
lines.en: Those scorch marks under the barn. Did you do them?

lines.zh: 那是本王布的玻璃珠法阵。
lines.en: That is the glass-bead formation this king laid.

lines.zh: 阳光一照，珠子聚成火点——防贼、防盗、防黑毛。
lines.en: When the sun hits, the beads gather into a point of fire — against thieves, against robbers, against black fur.

lines.zh: 所以下面稻草是被聚光点着的？
lines.en: So the straw below was lit by a focused point of light?

lines.zh: 烧着稻草……那是阵法余波。
lines.en: Burning straw… that is the formation's aftershock.
It means this king's power was too fierce.
Go down.
Don't step on this king's treasures.
(Another long, smug caw)
Back again?
Just walking around.
Tours cost money.
The gem is still here.
No need to ask.
(The crow taps the white rock with a wingtip)
The case isn't solved.
What does that have to do with this king.
This king's kingdom is entirely normal.
(The crow crouches at the edge of the nest, quieter than usual)
The case is solved.

lines.zh: 本王知道。那就是块石头。
lines.en: This king knows. That is just a rock.
…You admit it now?

lines.zh: 本王从来都知道！爱心封印、鬼脸结界——
lines.en: This king always knew! The heart seal, the ghost-face ward—
The ghost face was drawn by the chicks.
…Part of the exam.

lines.zh: （乌鸦别过脸，翅尖把白石头往身下按了按）
lines.en: (The crow turns his face away and presses the white rock down with a wingtip)
And the black cat? Did you two make up?

lines.zh: 那只黑毛？！昨天凌晨四点又来本王阵法边缘晃。
lines.en: That black fur?! At four yesterday morning he was lurking at the edge of this king's formation again.

lines.zh: 本王用碎玻璃反光晃了他一眼——
lines.en: This king flashed broken glass in his eyes—
…Still not made up.

lines.zh: 本王不需要和好。全农场最高的王，不需要。
lines.en: This king does not need to make up. The highest king on the farm does not need to.
Go down, hat-wearer.

lines.zh: （乌鸦用翅膀盖住白石头，低下头）
lines.en: (The crow covers the white rock with a wing and lowers his head)

lines.zh: 都是本王亲自设计的考题！
lines.en: All of it was an exam this king designed personally!
He just went down, tail swinging.
Hey, what are you doing?

lines.zh: （四只小鸡挤在鸡舍边，各自戴着歪歪扭扭的纸板墨镜装酷）
lines.en: (Four chicks crowd by the coop, each in crooked cardboard sunglasses, acting cool)
(Quiet) Someone's here…
Don't, don't look at him…
(Aman shifts half a step forward, then stops)

lines.zh: 淑芬的蛋不见了，你们知道吗？
lines.en: Shufen's egg is gone. Do you know?
(Aman's sunglasses slide to the tip of his beak)
(Very quiet) Little brother…
(Urgent) Guazi! Don't yell!
(Aman pushes the sunglasses back up)

lines.zh: 我们……暗影侦探团……也在查这案子。
lines.en: We… the Shadow Detective Crew… are also on this case.

lines.zh: 事情不小。你最好别乱插手。
lines.en: This is big. You'd better not meddle.
Can you tell me anything?
(Doudou tugs Aman's wing)
Internal intel. Can't tell outsiders.
You have to say something.
(Mili and Doudou look at each other)
…We're busy. Really.
Right. Field work is booked solid.

lines.zh: （瓜子低着头，喙动了动，没出声）
lines.en: (Guazi keeps his head down. His beak moves. No sound)
…Anything else?
What are you actually up to?

lines.zh: 谷仓角落草窝，知道谁的吗？
lines.en: The grass nest in the barn corner. Know whose it is?

lines.zh: 大黄宿醉那样，怎么叫醒？
lines.en: Dahuang's that hungover. How do I wake him?

lines.zh: 这玩意儿，你们怎么解释？
lines.en: This thing. How do you explain it?

lines.zh: 我准备上谷仓顶找乌鸦。
lines.en: I'm going up to the barn roof to find the crow.
Nothing. I'm going.

lines.zh: 鸡舍边上那些乱七八糟的痕迹——和你们有关吧。
lines.en: Those messy marks by the coop — they have to do with you, don't they.
(Aman shrinks his neck)
…That's…
De-detective tools…
(The four chicks pack tighter)
Talk! What are you hiding from me!

lines.zh: （哭腔）水怪……水怪把弟弟叼走了……
lines.en: (Tearful) The swamp monster… the swamp monster carried little brother off…
Yes!! It was the swamp monster!!
(Aman nods hard toward the pond)
Three heads! Green all over!

lines.zh: 从池塘爬上来！把蛋拖进水里了！！
lines.en: It climbed out of the pond! Dragged the egg into the water!!
You saw it yourself?
Did-didn't see… but it definitely was!!

lines.zh: 昨晚外面那声音……青蛙也说过……
lines.en: That sound outside last night… the frog said so too…
(Shaking) Otherwise how could little brother be gone…

lines.zh: 池塘那只青蛙肯定见过！！
lines.en: The frog at the pond must have seen it!!
Go ask him!! Please go!!
(Aman's sunglasses are crooked. He doesn't bother to fix them)

lines.zh: 谷仓角落有个草窝，你们知道是谁的吗？
lines.en: There's a grass nest in the barn corner. Do you know whose it is?
(Aman frowns)

lines.zh: 谷仓角落？不在我们巡逻范围。
lines.en: The barn corner? Not in our patrol range.
(Quiet) I… I didn't notice that side.

lines.zh: 问错地方了！我们只守鸡舍这边！
lines.en: Wrong place! We only guard the coop side!
…Nothing worth saying.

lines.zh: 大黄宿醉成那样，有什么法子叫醒他吗？
lines.en: Dahuang's that hungover. Any way to wake him?
(Doudou bounces. His sunglasses go crooked)

lines.zh: 大黄叔叔？他还在那儿躺着？！
lines.en: Uncle Dahuang? He's still lying there?!
(Aman holds Doudou down)
Is there a way?

lines.zh: （阿满压低声音，翅膀尖抖了一下）
lines.en: (Aman lowers his voice. A wingtip shakes)

lines.zh: 鸡舍水槽边，有老谷物泡的水。他爱喝。灌下去就醒。……拿去，算侦探团对前辈的关照。
lines.en: By the coop trough, there's old grain-soaked water. He likes it. Pour it down him and he wakes. …Take it. Call it the detective crew looking after a senior.
(Quiet) …Can we help this time?
Huh? What's on the barn roof?

lines.zh: 大黄说——乌鸦把蛋叼上屋顶了。
lines.en: Dahuang said — the crow carried the egg up to the roof.
…The roof?
(Quiet) The egg…?

lines.zh: 乌鸦还守在上面。我得上去看看。
lines.en: The crow is still up there guarding it. I have to go look.

lines.zh: （阿满跟另外三只对视一眼；豆豆嘴张了张，没出声）
lines.en: (Aman looks at the other three. Doudou's mouth opens, and nothing comes out)
(Very quiet) Could it be…
(Urgent) Guazi!
(Wind blows past the coop)
(None of the four chicks looks at the others)
(Aman starts to fix his sunglasses and freezes)
(The four chicks shut their mouths together)

lines.zh: 你们猜，我千辛万苦爬上去，在乌鸦那儿找到什么了？
lines.en: Guess what I found, after all that climbing, up there with the crow?
(The four chicks look at each other. Nobody speaks)
…The egg?
Talk! What is this! What happened!

lines.zh: （四只小鸡凑过来，又猛地僵住）
lines.en: (The four chicks crowd in, then freeze)
…We drew it.
(The sunglasses clatter to the ground)

lines.zh: 那不是老妈的蛋……乌鸦叼走的是假的……
lines.en: That isn't Mom's egg… what the crow took was a fake…
(Crying) Then little brother — where is little brother—
(Aman covers his face with a wing)
Waaah — I confess!!
From the start.

lines.zh: 大前天下午，我们捡了块白石头，画成蛋的样子，放进窝里假装是蛋，
lines.en: The afternoon before last we found a white rock, drew it to look like an egg, put it in the nest pretending it was the egg,

lines.zh: 然后把真的弟弟偷出来——
lines.en: Then we stole the real little brother out—
(Quiet) To play ball.

lines.zh: 踢……球？你们拿弟弟当球踢？
lines.en: Play… ball? You used your little brother as a ball?
(Several chicks look down and say nothing)
And then?

lines.zh: 有沼泽水怪，晚上爬出来，专门吃沾了泥土的蛋！
lines.en: There's a swamp monster. It comes out at night and specially eats eggs that got mud on them!

lines.zh: （气鼓鼓）现在想起来他们全程在憋笑！！
lines.en: (Puffed up) Now I remember they were holding in laughter the whole time!!
Hurry and push the real egg back into the nest!
And the fake rock?

lines.zh: 假石头嘛……大前天随手扔进草丛了……
lines.en: The fake rock… we tossed it in the grass the day before yesterday…
(Quiet) Later… the crow carried it off.

lines.zh: 那大黄说乌鸦叼蛋上屋顶——？
lines.en: Then when Dahuang said the crow carried an egg to the roof—?
(The four chicks look at each other)

lines.zh: 大黄叔叔喝了两天酒，日子都搅糊涂了……
lines.en: Uncle Dahuang drank for two days. He mixed the days up…

lines.zh: （哭）乌鸦叼走的是我们画的假石头——大前天的事！
lines.en: (Crying) What the crow carried off was the fake rock we drew — that was the day before yesterday!
Was there a noise last night?

lines.zh: 睡前弟弟还在……半夜一看，窝空了……
lines.en: Little brother was still there at bedtime… in the middle of the night the nest was empty…

lines.zh: 外面有好响的声音……我们以为是水怪……
lines.en: There was a really loud sound outside… we thought it was the swamp monster…

lines.zh: （哭）如果没有水怪……到底是谁带走了弟弟？
lines.en: (Crying) If there is no swamp monster… who took little brother?
(Aman slumps)

lines.zh: ……以后再也不偷弟弟出去踢球了。
lines.en: …We'll never steal little brother out to play ball again.
(The coop is very quiet)
(Very quiet) Great detective…
(Even quieter) Don't look at me…
(Low) Stand up straight.
Shufen is still crying.
…We know.
(Tearful) It's our fault…
Great detective.
Hm?

lines.zh: 要是……要是弟弟真在红顶屋……
lines.en: If… if little brother really is in the red-roof house…
We'll go and admit it.
(Quiet) …Mm.
Not sure yet.
(Aman nods once)
Do you regret it?
(None of the four chicks makes a sound)
…We regret it.
(Hoarse) The Shadow Detective Crew… messed it up.
I… I won't yell about the swamp monster anymore.
Don't bring it up again.

lines.zh: （四只小鸡坐在鸡舍门口；阿满墨镜搁在脚边）
lines.en: (The four chicks sit at the coop door. Aman's sunglasses are by his feet)

lines.zh: 告诉你们一个好消息——弟弟出壳了。
lines.en: Good news — little brother hatched.
(The four chicks look up)
…He really came out?

lines.zh: 出来了。自己在窝里叫呢。
lines.en: He did. He's calling in the nest himself.
(Doudou turns his head and rubs his eyes with a wing)
I'm not crying.

lines.zh: ……那段日子，我们天天盼他没事。
lines.en: …Those days, we hoped every day he was all right.
It's all right now.
(Low) Mm… actually, back then, we were really scared.

lines.zh: 那老鼠骗你们编水怪的事——还打算算账吗？
lines.en: That thing about the mice tricking you into making up a swamp monster — still planning to settle it?
(Doudou throws a wing up)
We will!! We have to settle it with them!!
(Cuts in) …
(Aman puts the sunglasses back on)
The Shadow Detective Crew has its own arrangements.
(Quiet) They made it up way too far…
(Low) Doudou, heard you.

lines.zh: （豆豆用力点头；米粒、瓜子也跟着点）
lines.en: (Doudou nods hard. Mili and Guazi nod too)

lines.zh: （四只小鸡排成一列，墨镜戴正了）
lines.en: (The four chicks line up. Sunglasses on straight)
Colleagues.
Another job?
A walk.
(Low) And to see if the mice are in.
(Low) Doudou!!
A new case?

lines.zh: 没有。弟弟刚出壳，别出去疯。
lines.en: No. Little brother just hatched. Don't go out and run wild.
(Guazi stares into the coop)
Looking at what?
Looking at little brother.
(A thin call comes from the nest)
(Quiet) He looked this way just now.
…Still investigating. Don't touch our scene.
The pond… did you go?
…Field work is paused. If you've got something, say it fast.
(The four chicks crowd together again)

lines.zh: 黑猫让我来问——你们这两天到底发生了什么？我在乌鸦那儿看见一块白石头，跟你们有关吧。
lines.en: The black cat sent me to ask — what actually happened to you these two days? I saw a white rock with the crow. It has to do with you, doesn't it.
(The four chicks freeze)

lines.zh: （哭腔）我们……我们把弟弟弄丢了……
lines.en: (Tearful) We… we lost little brother…

lines.zh: 推着弟弟路过谷仓时，老鼠叔叔蹿出来说——
lines.en: While we were pushing little brother past the barn, Uncle Mouse jumped out and said—

lines.zh: 弟弟当时已经推回窝了。真要不见，是昨晚！
lines.en: Little brother had already been pushed back into the nest by then. If he really vanished, it was last night!

lines.zh: 昨晚那声响……青蛙说不定听见了。去问问他……求你……
lines.en: That sound last night… the frog might have heard it. Go ask him… please…

lines.zh: 然后把真的弟弟偷出来——踢球。
lines.en: Then we stole the real little brother out — to play ball.

lines.zh: 有沼泽水怪，专门吃沾泥的蛋！
lines.en: There's a swamp monster that specially eats muddy eggs!

lines.zh: 我们吓得跑去池塘洗蛋，又被青蛙的话吓着了——
lines.en: We got scared and ran to the pond to wash the egg, and then the frog's words scared us too—

lines.zh: 弟弟是昨晚才不见的！跟那一趟不是一回事！
lines.en: Little brother only vanished last night! It's not the same thing as that trip!

lines.zh: （压声）昨晚外面那声音……肯定是水怪干的……
lines.en: (Low) That sound outside last night… it had to be the swamp monster…

lines.zh: （压声）池塘那边青蛙还说，宝珠沉下去了……
lines.en: (Low) The frog over at the pond also said the jewel sank…

lines.zh: （极小声）……可是大前天……明明是我们自己……
lines.en: (Very quiet) …But the day before yesterday… it was clearly us…
(Low) Guazi! Stop talking!

lines.zh: （压声）那要是有人来问，咱们怎么说？
lines.en: (Low) Then if someone comes asking, what do we say?

lines.zh: （压声）就说……水怪。从池塘来的。把蛋叼走了……
lines.en: (Low) We say… the swamp monster. It came from the pond. It carried the egg off…

lines.zh: （压声）只能是这样……不然弟弟怎么会不见……
lines.en: (Low) It has to be that… otherwise how could little brother be gone…

Dahuang's collar is silver-plated.

lines.zh: 青蛙年轻时是这片水域的第一情圣。
lines.en: In his youth the frog was the greatest romantic on these waters.

lines.zh: 淑芬十年前是隔壁村的斗鸡冠军。
lines.en: Ten years ago Shufen was the next village's cockfighting champion.

lines.zh: Flash 是隔壁农场派来的商业间谍，画了三年地图了。
lines.en: Flash is a commercial spy from the next farm. He's been mapping this place for three years.

lines.zh: 主人是鸡科圣手，尤其精通《母鸡的产后护理》。
lines.en: The owner calls himself a chicken specialist, especially Aftercare for Hens.

lines.zh: 大橡树会走路——一年挪一厘米。
lines.en: The great oak can walk — one centimeter a year.

lines.zh: 上次大黄偷喝主人的发酵苹果渣，是淑芬用谷物泡水叫醒的。
lines.en: Last time Dahuang stole the owner's fermented apple mash, Shufen woke him with grain-soaked water.

lines.zh: 主人这几天常趴窗看鸡舍方向——看完又不进去。
lines.en: These days the owner keeps peering toward the coop — then doesn't go in.

lines.zh: 小鸡昨晚都缩在鸡舍里不出来，像在等什么
lines.en: Last night the chicks all stayed in the coop, like they were waiting for something

lines.zh: 黑猫前天下午自己爬上过谷仓顶
lines.en: The afternoon before last, the black cat climbed the barn roof by himself

lines.zh: 水怪是老鼠兄弟随口编的。
lines.en: The swamp monster was something the mouse brothers made up.

lines.zh: 乌鸦前天早上从鸡舍门口草丛搞了个东西回屋顶。
lines.en: The morning before last, the crow took something from the grass by the coop door back to the roof.

lines.zh: 昨晚红顶屋里亮黄灯，墙里嗡嗡响——像有个不会落山的小太阳。
lines.en: Last night a yellow light burned in the red-roof house and the walls hummed — like a little sun that never sets.

lines.zh: 昨晚主人雨靴来回两趟——一趟带湿泥，一趟朝鸡舍。
lines.en: Last night the owner's rain boots made two trips — one with wet mud, one toward the coop.

lines.zh: 昨晚那阵'水怪低吼'其实是大黄打的呼噜。
lines.en: That 'swamp monster growl' last night was actually Dahuang snoring.

lines.zh: 黑猫昨晚在篱笆边和自己的影子咬耳朵。
lines.en: Last night the black cat whispered to his own shadow by the fence.

lines.zh: 以前还有一家卖情报的，被老鼠兄弟搞垮了。
lines.en: There used to be another intel shop. The mouse brothers ran it out of business.

lines.zh: Flash 昨晚从宽叶上飞起来盘旋了一圈。
lines.en: Last night Flash lifted off a broad leaf, circled once, and landed.
